|-----------|--------|------|

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as "User CLI"
    participant Runner as "IterativeTDDRunner"
    participant Planner as "IncrementalPlanner"
    participant CycleRunner as "TDDCycleRunner"
    participant Pod as "PythonLanguagePod"
    participant Worker as "WorkerAgent"
    participant LLM as "LLMClient"
    participant Orchestrator as "PodmanOrchestrator"
    participant Container as "PodmanRunner Container"
    participant Logger as "ExperimentLogger"
    participant Reflector as "Reflector"
    participant Curator as "Curator"
    participant Playbook as "PlaybookManager"

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    loop Cycle Loop (max iterations)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

        Runner->>CycleRunner: run( Podspec)
        Note over CycleRunner: RED Phase
        CycleRunner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: test code
        Worker-->>Pod: test code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test_file_only)
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult (output, error)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Note over Pod: commit test to disk if not security breach
        Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult (passed=False)

        alt RED aborted (security or parse failure)
            CycleRunner->>CycleRunner: abort cycle
        else RED passed (test fails correctly)
            Note over CycleRunner: GREEN phase with retries
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                LLM-->>Worker: implem code
                Worker->>Pod: implem code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test_+ impl)
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult
                alt passed
                    break
                else failed & not abort
                    CycleRunner->>CycleRunner: set error_ feedback
                end
            end

            alt GREEN passed
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                Worker->>LLM: generate
                LLM-->>Worker: refactored code
                Worker-->>Pod: refactored code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>CycleRunner: PhaseResult
            end
        end

        CycleRunner-->>Runner: CycleResult

        alt Learning enabled & GREEN passed
            Runner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            Reflector-->>Runner: ReflectorOutput
            Runner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
            Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullet IDs
            Curator-->>Runner: CuratorOutput
        end

        Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
    end

    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
```
